2610.08076.title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
2610.08076.paper_summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.
2610.08076.paper_summary_zh: 前沿的 LLM 代理已被證明能夠解決越來越複雜的任務，而這些任務是人類可以量化解決的。這引出了相關的問題，即 LLM 代理是否能超越人類已經解決的問題。隨著人類開發的解決方案對於缺乏背景或足夠訓練數據的問題變得不再足夠，開發複雜策略以應對重要問題的能力變得至關重要。我們通過共同的視頻遊戲速通實踐來研究代理的策略形成能力。在速通中，從業者競爭以尋找在特定條件下完成視頻遊戲的最快方法，並在此過程中發現有趣的非正統遊玩風格，這些風格需要對基礎遊戲機制有徹底的理解和掌握。我們介紹了 SPEEDRUNBENCH，一個評估前沿 LLM 代理在 9 款不同遊戲中的基準。為了在這個基準中表現良好，代理必須不斷改進他們的策略，反思他們的表現，利用他們獲得的知識，並在長期行動中推理，以改善一個越來越困難的問題：比自己和其他人更快。我們的實驗顯示，雖然前沿代理在簡單的平臺遊戲中接近人類世界紀錄，但在實際預算下，它們在較長且更複雜的遊戲中仍然落後於人類表現。這些結果表明，SPEEDRUNBENCH 是研究代理策略形成能力的有用測試平台，同時也是一個抗飽和的評估指標，因為幾乎總是有更快的完成時間等待被發現。
